title: Rav Yitzchak Shlomo Linder
body: Rav Yitzchak Shlomo Linder zt”l, 80, of Yerushalayim's Yerushalayim–Masmidim community, passed away. He was a distinguished melamed at the Boyan Talmud Torah in Yerushalayim. A levayah took place Motzaei Shabbos.

title: Yeshiva Bochur Released
body: A Chevron Yeshiva talmid, Yehuda ben Amram, is set to be released from military prison and return to the yeshiva after a festive reception. The news brings relief and anticipation to the campus.
